reasoning: This question asks about comparing temperatures on two specific dates (March 22 vs March 15, 2026) at Orly station. The evidence provides seasonal forecasts indicating warmer-than-normal spring temperatures are likely (50% probability), but no specific forecasts for these exact dates. In mid-March, temperatures typically show an upward trend as spring progresses. March 22 is one week after March 15, and climatologically, daily average temperatures in Paris/Orly region tend to increase by roughly 0.2-0.3°C per day in March.
